notes.title: New game: "Discolored - Episode 2" official announcement!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Hope you are well! The new game I've been working on, Discolored - Episode 2 is officially announced! It took a bit longer to get everything ready (typical of game development) but finally I can start showing off what to expect in Episode 2!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/22be0aa44bcd92381031d98cc84b5347ebaffa76.png
View the Steam page for Episode 2!

And now for a few teasers of what to expect from Episode 2!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/9485df5a3486ffa2e231f2b41d6129ca7d05fd5c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/a36a7a01dd8de92d00d745516f97ccd8d2af477c.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/fb69ed2162f92a3654384886bb00130a24c5f0cf.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/522a4ff5694d778b9c658a94583d3658c19b4f3f.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/a76cf820880f5030b9b8ac43b317e2c5887ed766.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/11b3909625795b8e63e1972c0d1e177e210f6545.gif
Check out the game's Steam page (link above) where you can view the trailer and screenshots and if you like what you see it would really help if you could wishlist the game (please). :) Steam keeps track of how quickly and how many wishlists a game gets and if the numbers are high enough it will show the game to more people that browse Steam. In turn hopefully that will lead to the game doing well and I can continue to expand the world of Discolored.

This game will build out the story more and you will run into a couple of characters that can help or harm you in your quest to restore the missing colors. It will play mostly the same as Episode 1 with reality-bending puzzles, an atmospheric soundtrack, and a striking color palette. But there will also be more intense moments where you have to think on your feet because in this episode the evil organization that has stolen all the colors are trying to stop you from bringing them back.

Join the Newsletter or Discord
Want to play the demo? If you'd like to take part in a beta test of the demo join the mailing list or Discord and I'll be sending out news later with instructions on how you can sign up to play the demo and give feedback. So sign up and stay tuned!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/3e2206ff9c63486fcbaf27e22f4f27ed4572609d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/1e16266dc9fb2bf7ead726fe3252a8c2b4079cee.png

Release date?
Right now I can't give a firm release date on when Episode 2 will be completed. I want to make this game much longer than the first episode. If I had to give a timeframe it might be another year and a half before Episode 2 is complete. But it's game dev, so it could be even be longer. But I'm really excited about the ideas I have for this one so I won't be giving up on it and I'll do everything I can to make it best game it can possibly be!


Thank you,
Jason


P.S. I'd love to hear what you think based on what you see on the Steam page. Feel free to reply to this thread to share your thoughts!

notes.title: Soundtrack DLC
notes.content:
The soundtrack for The Search is now live! 5 mp3 tracks from the game are now free to download.

Track Listing:
1. The Threshold (0:39) - Jason Godbey
2. Ouendake (3:32) - Goldmund (Keith Kenniff)
3. Unseen Forces At Work (2:55) - Jewelbeat
4. Web Of Deceit (2:06) - Jewelbeat
5. The Search (2:09) - Jewelbeat

They will show up as a zip file in your Steam directory: ...Steam\steamapps\common\The Search
